name: workbench_manuscript
description:
Read, save or import an editable manuscript and its image assets.
Input is a project, action and source document or file; output is the native document or upload receipt.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

action.description: Editable manuscript operation

document.description: Existing Tiptap document and manuscript fields; save requires its revision

revision.description: Explicit current revision, overriding document.revision when supplied

file_path.description: Local document to import or image asset to upload

name: workbench_manuscript_templates
description:
Inspect supported manuscript templates and retrieve their actual source or preview.
Input is a catalog action or selected template and destination; output is native metadata or a local artifact.

action.description: Read template catalog, rendered preview or original source

kind.description: Template ID returned by the actual catalog

output_path.description: Destination file required for preview or original source downloads

name: workbench_manuscript_export
description:
Submit a native manuscript export with its language and review settings.
Input is an owned project and export settings; output is the unchanged job ID for workbench_jobs polling.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

action.description: Submit the existing manuscript export operation

language.description: Document language basis; auto may prepare an English draft

document_id.description: Current reader document ID when exporting reader translation

columns.description: One or two columns, preserving backend default two

name: workbench_export_download
description:
Download a completed manuscript or presentation artifact.
Input is a project, export area, name and destination; output is the saved file descriptor.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

name.description: Exact completed export name from the native job result

output_path.description: Explicit destination for the native export bytes

action.description: Download an already completed export

name: workbench_references
description:
Maintain stable citations and request source-backed replacement or related-paper proposals.
Input is a project and citation action with its revision or source metadata; output is the native document, proposal or state.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

action.description: Canonical citation operation

reference_id.description: Stable existing reference ID for recommend, replace or related

entry.description: Selected source metadata, including title and DOI

revision.description: Current manuscript revision required for add and replace

query.description: Optional real search query for replacement recommendations

instruction.description: Specific recommendation request; omitted preserves backend instruction

paragraph.description: Reviewed replacement paragraph preserving citation numbers

expected_text.description: Exact paragraph from the recommendation receipt

years.description: Related-paper range, zero means all years

source.description: Actual configured search provider or auto

name: workbench_journals
description:
Find journals, inspect sourced metrics or generate a supported journal preview.
Input is journal criteria or a project and selected layout; output is native metadata or a preview job ID.

action.description: Journal discovery, sourced details or manuscript preview

query.description: Journal search words; empty returns generic template choices

journal_id.description: Selected journal ID; preview omission preserves generic-zh default

project_id.description: Owned project required for generating a journal preview

columns.description: Journal preview column count, preserving backend default one

name: workbench_journal_templates
description:
Discover and retain original official journal author-template packages.
Input is a journal or cached candidate selection; output is source provenance, a receipt or the original local file.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

action.description: Discover official candidates, retain a selected package or fetch its file

journal.description: Journal ID required for source discovery and selected candidate download

template_id.description: Actual cached template candidate ID for download

name.description: Exact retained template filename for file retrieval

output_path.description: Destination file required for retrieving retained template bytes

name: workbench_figure
description:
Inspect, preview and save actual registered Matplotlib figure objects.
Input is a project image and source-supported revisioned patches; output is native figure state or its save receipt.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

path.description: Image path relative to the project's program directory

action.description: Inspect actual plot objects, preview changes or save them

revision.description: Actual inspected figure revision required for preview/save

changes.description: Native figure, objects and layout patches using actual inspected object IDs

start_edit_session.description: Create the backend figure editing session during inspection

include_context.description: Also return native image/manuscript/source-program context during inspection

name: workbench_figure_chat
description:
Read or continue source-bound figure conversations and linked agent replies.
Input is an image, discussion action and optional selected objects; output is native messages, proposal or session state.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

action.description: Read image discussion, send a request or inspect an associated session

message.description: Request required for send; model-backed replies retain source limits

image_path.description: Optional local PNG snapshot for the native discussion

include_context.description: Include actual figure/source context in the model request

session_id.description: Existing session previously associated with this figure

name: workbench_image_review
description:
Prepare or submit an image review retaining source programs and annotations.
Input is a project image, local PNG and request; output is the native prepared-review or agent receipt.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

path.description: Existing image path relative to the project program directory

image_path.description: Local PNG review image or cropped screenshot

action.description: Prepare or submit the existing native image-review operation

send.description: Submit to the native agent; false saves only a prepared review

name: workbench_raster
description:
Save edited bitmap pixels while retaining the previous native image version.
Input is a project image, local PNG and optional timestamp; output is the native save receipt or conflict.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

path.description: Existing bitmap path relative to the project program directory

image_path.description: Local complete PNG containing edited pixels

action.description: Save pixels through the existing version-preserving image endpoint

expected_modified.description: Original file timestamp for optimistic conflict detection

name: workbench_slide_templates
description:
Inspect, upload, prepare and configure the original presentation templates.
Input is a project and template lifecycle action; output is the native catalog, manifest, selection or preparation job ID.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

action.description: Inspect or configure a project-private presentation template

template.description: Actual catalog template ID; roles requires uploaded

file_path.description: Local editable PPTX required for upload

roles.description: Native role-to-page mapping for an uploaded template

name: workbench_slides
description:
Manage audience-confirmed slide content and its original editable exports.
Input is a project and explicit slide lifecycle action; output is native plan, confirmation, job ID or preview artifact.

project_id.description: Owned research project ID

action.description: Native slide plan, confirmation, export or preview operation

template.description: Actual selected template; confirm only after the user's choice

profile.description: User-selected audience and purpose required for confirm

plan.description: Existing editable slide plan with sections and applicable confirmation ID

instruction.description: Specific instructions for model-backed slide planning

length.description: Native planning length, normally short, medium or long

use_native.description: Use the assigned native model for planning

confirmation_id.description: Current explicit confirmation receipt required by the backend

kind.description: deck or a catalog template ID for a rendered preview

name: workbench_account
description:
Inspect the current Workbench account and authentication state.
Input selects an account view; output preserves its native identity/profile fields.

action.description: Read the current identity, authentication status or account profile

name: workbench_projects
description:
List, create or rename research projects through the original application.
Input is an action and its project/name fields; output is the native project result.

action.description: List projects, create one, or rename an existing owned project

project_id.description: Existing project ID required for update

name.description: Project name of 1 to 100 characters for create or update

name: workbench_files
description:
Manage current project files while preserving native conflict and history behavior.
Input supplies project-relative paths or local uploads; output is native state or an absolute artifact.

project_id.description: Existing owned Workbench project ID

action.description: Project file operation

path.description: Project-relative file path or directory; empty lists the root

content.description: Exact UTF-8 text to save for write

file_paths.description: Local files to upload into path, each at most 256 MiB

expected_modified.description: Existing modification timestamp for optimistic write conflict detection

reason.description: Reason saved in native replacement history

output_dir.description: Optional local download base directory; a fresh child is created per read

name: workbench_revisions
description:
Inspect or restore the application's recoverable artifact revisions.
Input identifies a native revision; output is history, a native diff, preview or restoration result.

project_id.description: Existing owned project ID

action.description: Inspect or restore native recoverable history

revision_id.description: Native trash/revision ID required for inspect or restore

view.description: Readable history difference or original preview

output_dir.description: Download base directory for preview; each call creates a fresh child

name: workbench_rules
description:
Read existing Workbench task rules and source integration contracts.
Input selects a rule/context view; output preserves the actual published instructions or schema.

action.description: Read task standards, a named skill, API schema or project integration context

project_id.description: Owned project ID required for context

identifier.description: Skill identifier returned by standards, required for skill

name: workbench_storage
description:
Inspect the current account's storage usage and quota.
Input selects usage; output is the native storage and cache report.

action.description: Read account quota, file and cache usage

name: workbench_knowledge_bases
description:
Manage knowledge-base resources in the owned project's native workspace scope.
Input supplies existing IDs or new-KB sources; output preserves native metadata and indexing task IDs.

project_id.description: Owned project used to resolve the actual native workspace scope

action.description: List assignable resources, inspect/create a KB, or bind visible KB IDs

knowledge_base.description: Native qualified knowledge-base ID for details

name.description: Name for a new knowledge base

knowledge_bases.description: Exact visible qualified IDs to bind; an explicit empty list clears bindings

file_paths.description: Optional local source files; no files creates a native empty KB

rag_provider.description: Source-supported native provider identifier, fixed for the new KB

search_mode.description: Optional search mode supported by the selected native provider

rel_paths.description: Optional upload-relative paths aligned with local files

indexing_llm.description: Legacy native indexing selection; current upstream may reject per-KB overrides

embedding_model.description: Native configured profile_id/model_id selection, without secrets

name: workbench_knowledge_files
description:
Read, append or organize native knowledge-base source files.
Input supplies scoped KB paths or local files; output is native file state, text preview or an artifact.

project_id.description: Owned project supplying the native workspace scope

knowledge_base.description: Actual qualified knowledge-base ID visible in that scope

action.description: Native KB source-file operation

view.description: Original bytes or the actual plain-text extraction preview

rel_paths.description: Optional source-relative paths aligned with uploaded files

dest_subdir.description: Optional organizational destination for an upload batch

rag_provider.description: Optional provider check; must match the KB's fixed provider

image_analysis.description: Native pinned image-analysis policy; omitted preserves that policy

dest_folder.description: Destination folder for a move; empty selects KB root

output_dir.description: Download base directory for original files; a fresh child is created

name: workbench_knowledge_index
description:
Inspect and control the existing native knowledge indexing lifecycle.
Input identifies the scoped KB/run; output preserves readiness, durable state or retry/cancel acceptance.

project_id.description: Owned project supplying native workspace access

action.description: Inspect index state, retry failed work, or request safe-boundary cancellation

task_id.description: Native indexing-run task ID required for cancel

name: workbench_search_sources
description:
Inspect the actual configured discovery sources for the current account.
Input selects status; output contains native source names and availability flags.

action.description: Read actual paper, web, institution and metrics provider configuration flags

name: workbench_web_search
description:
Search real web pages through the Workbench discovery provider.
Input is a query and source-supported domain filter; output is the native search response.

action.description: Search using the account's actual configured web provider

kind.description: Use general search or the source's publisher-domain filter

name: workbench_paper_search
description:
Search existing literature providers and retain stable native selection identities.
Input is a project query/provider/window/page; output preserves bibliographic records and source status.

project_id.description: Owned project anchoring the discovery task

action.description: Search bibliographic sources without claiming full-text verification

source.description: Native provider selection; configured credentials remain server-side

years.description: Publication-year window; zero applies no year filter

newest.description: Request the upstream source's newest-first ordering

limit.description: Results from 1 to 20; Scholar MCP natively caps this at 10

name: workbench_literature
description:
Manage source-bound literature attachments without replacing their identity checks.
Input supplies PDF files or native source identities; output is attachment metadata, original bytes or a preview.

project_id.description: Existing owned research project ID

action.description: List, attach, identify or read source documents

asset.description: Actual project-literature or linked-KB relative source path

library.description: workspace or an actual project-bound native KB ID

file_paths.description: Local PDF files for upload, each at most 100 MiB

folder.description: Purpose category for new PDF attachments

output_dir.description: Local download base directory; a fresh child is created per artifact

name: workbench_literature_organization
description:
Organize research sources by purpose and native source-based classification.
Input identifies sources or requests classification; output is assignments, classification state or a native job ID.

project_id.description: Existing owned project ID

action.description: Read/assign purpose folders or inspect/request source-based classification

asset.description: Actual source identity required for assign

name: workbench_paper_downloads
description:
Use the existing authorized document-download queue and its real progress.
Input supplies source identities or task IDs; output retains queue, transfer and receipt states.

action.description: Queue or inspect the existing authorized ScanSci download pipeline

project_id.description: Owned project ID required except for worker_status

entries.description: One to 100 source-supported DOI/arXiv/title metadata entries

job_id.description: Native download task ID for retry or cancel

name: workbench_reader
description:
Open and inspect the actual project-bound PDF reading protocol.
Input identifies a real source/document/block; output preserves parsed source blocks, saved states or artifacts.

project_id.description: Owned project containing the manuscript or source PDF

action.description: Open a real source PDF, read its native blocks/state, or locate an image

asset.description: Actual source path; manuscript/main.json is the current manuscript

library.description: workspace or the actual bound KB for literature; empty for manuscript

document_id.description: Native reader document ID returned by open

view.description: Native parsed content, saved translations, options or original PDF

block_id.description: Native image block ID required for image

output_dir.description: Download base directory for the original PDF; each call creates a fresh child

name: workbench_translation
description:
Translate existing source content through the application's native model protocols.
Input selects a manuscript or reader document; output retains native jobs or accepted reader operations.

project_id.description: Owned project containing the selected manuscript or source PDF

action.description: Translate an editable manuscript, start native PDF translation or export saved PDF translation

target.description: Target language; reader_start accepts en or zh-CN

use_native.description: Use the assigned native model for manuscript translation instead of the saved Workbench API

source.description: Translate the source manuscript or its existing editable translation

document_id.description: Actual native reader document ID for reader_start or export_pdf

columns.description: Columns in the native saved-translation PDF export

name: workbench_annotations
description:
Manage questions anchored to actual project artifacts and native audit history.
Input is an annotation record or selected question IDs; output is native annotated state or submission receipt.

project_id.description: Owned project containing the real annotated artifact

action.description: Read, create/update anchored questions or submit selected native question IDs

area.description: Optional list filter or annotation content area

asset.description: Actual artifact path or source identity

identifier.description: Existing annotation ID required for update

payload.description: Native annotation fields: title,quote,body,color,status,locator,origin; area/asset can also be supplied

ids.description: Selected annotation IDs required for submit

name: workbench_review
description:
Continue source-anchored review and record actual project changes and checks.
Input is chat context or a truthful receipt; output preserves native messages, events and receipt state.

project_id.description: Owned project containing the review context

action.description: Read review history/chat, send a source-anchored message or record verified work

area.description: Native content area for review chat

message.description: User-authorized review message, up to 16000 characters

locator.description: Native page/paragraph/file locator and optional current_draft editor object

question_ids.description: Existing project question IDs addressed by a receipt

artifacts.description: Native receipt artifact records with existing project-root-relative path

validation.description: Actual textual or structured validation results for the receipt

limitations.description: Actual remaining limitations for the receipt

resolved.description: Mark only the supplied receipt question IDs resolved

name: workbench_jobs
description:
Read the actual state and outcomes of asynchronous project operations.
Input identifies a project and optional recent job; output retains native job status/result/error fields.

project_id.description: Owned project whose latest native jobs are read

action.description: Read actual queued/running/completed/failed/interrupted jobs

job_id.description: Optional job ID filter within the latest 20 native project jobs

name: workbench_settings
description:
Read masked account settings or update their explicitly supplied values.
Input contains setting changes; output is masked native configuration or saved/configured flags.

action.description: Read masked settings or merge explicitly supplied updates into current non-secret settings

base_url.description: Optional HTTPS model API base URL

api_key.description: Optional new model API key; omitted/empty retains the saved secret

translation_prompt.description: Optional custom translation instruction; empty resets to the native default

literature_token.description: Optional new native literature token; never returned

scholar_api_key.description: Optional new Scholar SerpApi key; never returned

wos_api_key.description: Optional new Web of Science key; never returned

web_search_api_key.description: Optional new web-search key; never returned

jcr_api_key.description: Optional new Clarivate metrics key; never returned

name: workbench_author_profile
description:
Manage manuscript author metadata independently of account authentication.
Input selects profile fields, manuscript context or institution search; output is native author data or candidates.

action.description: Read/update author details, read current manuscript front matter or search real institutions

project_id.description: Owned project ID required for preview

name.description: Author name; omitted fields retain current values on save

email.description: Author contact email, separate from login credentials

q.description: Institution query for the actual native ROR search

name: workbench_project_import
description:
Import a user-selected source-bound research material bundle.
Input is the native manifest ZIP; output retains its asynchronous import job ID.

project_id.description: Owned destination project for the selected source bundle

file_path.description: Local ZIP up to 300 MiB with workbench-import.json and the required editable DOCX manuscript

action.description: Submit the source-supported native material import

name: workbench_knowledge_search
description:
Retrieve source passages from the project's real PDFs or bound native index.
Input is a scoped query/mode; output preserves native passages, coverage, errors and provenance.

project_id.description: Owned project limiting retrieval to its PDFs and bound native knowledge bases

query.description: Actual source query, trimmed/truncated to 600 characters by upstream; minimum length two

action.description: Retrieve through the existing source-text or native semantic operation

mode.description: PDF/native text preview keywords or the original indexed native RAG

knowledge_base.description: Optional project-bound KB ID; required for semantic mode
